assertion_independence: No new assertion directly compares a code-under-test output against the same value passed into that call. The candidate equality assertions at lines 356-358 compare two outputs derived from the stored candidate, so they establish handoff consistency but do not independently prove the population ran on that object.

failure_evidence.importer_after_result: 23 failed, 54 passed, EXIT=1; header labels revision 28d239f9 despite source manifest treating it as the post-repair compatibility arm

findings.text: The candidate merge and push run before crew complete; if completion refuses or fails after merge's dry-run check, primary carries unpromoted code while land_once records a refusal, and the new test mocks completion rather than exercising that failure.

Failing closed on missing suite_command is the required guard, but the recorded importer compatibility gate has 23 failures against a previously passing 77-case receipt; the plan's no-added-importer-failures measure remains unmet and the fixtures or callers need repair.

The candidate-handoff test replaces the real promotion dry run and completion, while the reviewed run's own promotion comparison records SuiteDeltaError for baseline_suite.revision_matches_base_sha; the passing CLI test cannot establish that this delivered run can pass the real landing gate.
